Short warm-start pre-pass (3 ep x 200 train) then per-scene Adam (400 steps) on each of 6 val scans, scored by evaluate_calibrated on the SAME val scenes as every other Mayo method. Bilateral stack has only 6 trainable params (proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 3 sigma each) so it is ~2x faster than the U-Net N2I; lr=5e-3 per Wagner-2022 BF recipe (CONFIG default). grad_clip=1.0 mandatory for Mayo 2304-view FBP adjoint. outer_wall_s=3000 fits the 1h sbatch wall: warm ~75s + 6x400x~0.125 s/(iter x scene) ~300s (smoke: bilateral ~2x faster than dual_domain_n2i ~0.25 s/step).
